MR Safety
Non-clinical testing has demonstrated that the Nova Pacemaker System is MR Conditional. A patient with this device can be safely scanned in an MR system meeting the following conditions:
• Static magnetic field of 1.5-Tesla and 3.0-Tesla
• a maximum spatial field gradient of 1,900 gauss/cm
• Maximum MR system reported, whole body averaged specific absorption rate (SAR) of 0.1 W/kg (Normal Operating Mode)
• head SAR ≤ 0.1 W/kg
• No more than 10 minutes of active scan time per session
• Followed by a wait time of 60 minutes
• Body transmit coil only
• Device configuration: Stimulation OFF
Under the scan conditions defined above, the Nova Pacemaker System is expected to produce a maximum temperature rise of less than 2.4 °C after 15 minutes of continuous scanning.
